Label: Date of First Exposure to Treatment
Date of Last Exposure to Treatment
Time to Event Origin Date for Subject
Analysis Date
Derivation: if ADAE.ASTDT is not missing and occurred after TRTSDT then ADAE.ASTDT else convert ADSL.RFENDTC to a SAS numeric date

Label: Censor
Derivation: if ADAE.TRTEMFL ="Y" then CNSR=0, else CNSR=1

Label: Event or Censoring Description
Derivation: if ADTTE.CNSR = 0 then "Dematologic Event Occured", else if ADTTE.CNSR =1 then "Study Completion Date"

Label: Source Domain
Derivation: The Source domain referred to in order to populate ADT (either ADAE or ADSL)

Label: Source Variable
Derivation: The Source variable referred to in order to populate ADT (either ASTDT or RFENDT)

Label: Source Sequence Number
Derivation: The value of ADAE.AESEQ if SRCDOM=ADAE, otherwise null.
